groups.title: 見る vs 観る vs 診る

members.nuance: General seeing, looking, or observing with the eyes.

members.nuance: General passive hearing of sounds, or asking a question.

members.nuance: Repairing broken physical objects or correcting mistakes and habits.

members.nuance: Curing illnesses, medical conditions, wounds, or injuries.

members.nuance: Early in time, schedule, hour, or clock time.

members.nuance: Fast in physical speed, motion, tempo, or velocity.
